cpsFeature.note: Platform BEHAVIOR of the embedded demo is governed by chrome-platform-showcase's own immutable conformance contract at conformanceRoute. gendn references it and does not fork or contradict its assertions.

assertions.describe: The stable route /v151/wheel-event-momentum/ responds 200 (durable-demo contract).
Page carries its canonical chromestatus.com/feature/6631012282007552 link — the immutable feature identity (CLAUDE.md invariant #3) and the milestone-151 mapping's self-heal.
Document has a non-empty <title> for the reference page.
Exactly one <h1> — the API name (listing name), MDN-shaped article heading.
A single <main> landmark wraps the article content.
Shared editorial design system /public/styles.css is linked.
Responsive viewport meta present (width=device-width) for mobile+desktop parity.
Breadcrumb links back to the /v151/ release index.
Byline footer present (article provenance).
Every target=_blank link carries rel=noopener (no reverse-tabnabbing; MDN-style external link hygiene).
No anchor has an empty or placeholder (#) href.
assertions.test: [...document.querySelectorAll('a')].every(el => { const h = el.getAttribute('href'); return h && h !== '#'; })

assertions.describe: Page loads with no console errors.
No failed (>=400 / net-error) network requests on load.
No unintended horizontal overflow at desktop (1280x800).
No unintended horizontal overflow at narrow mobile (360x740, DPR3).
Desktop render is legible, contrast passes WCAG AA, controls/text not clipped (screenshot review).
Mobile render is legible with adequate tap targets and no clipped text/controls (screenshot review).
The <h1> is the chromestatus milestone-listing name for this feature (not the broader detail name) — factual/source fidelity.
Frontend implementation consulted modern-web-guidance for its UI/responsive/a11y topics and applied or justified them (recorded in _questions.json guidanceConsulted).
Built reference has at least three <h2> sections (MDN-shaped depth).
Cross-browser support is documented (a support/compat/baseline section, or a reference table stating Baseline / Shipped-in / standards positions) — accurate messaging, not implied support.
Built reference includes a usable example surface (<pre> code and/or a live embed).
Code/IDL examples are correctly escaped (no attribute/element injection, invariant #4) and trace to the cited spec/IDL — no invented members (source review).

Embedded live example points at THIS feature's chrome-platform-showcase route (chrome-platform-showcase.paulkinlan-ea.deno.net/v151/wheel-event-momentum...) — the canonical demo identity, never repointed.

The embedded chrome-platform-showcase demo actually renders (not a blank box or error frame); its platform behavior is governed by the CPS conformance contract referenced in cpsFeature, not re-asserted here.
The stable member route (momentum/) resolves with HTTP 200 and renders all nine dimension sections with substantive text.
assertions.test: (async () => { const r = await fetch('./momentum/'); if (r.status !== 200) return false; const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(await r.text(), 'text/html'); for (const d of ['syntax','inputs','outputs','errors','context','lifecycle','examples','compatibility','security-privacy']) { const el = doc.getElementById(d); if (!el || el.parentElement.textContent.trim().length < 40) return false; } return true; })()

assertions.describe: The overview links the member route (implementation-sufficiency: overview explains the model and links every item).

Executable doc-quality check: the member page documents the exact spec contract — true iff platform-synthesized to simulate scroll inertia after the physical interaction ended; un-initialized and init-default are false; the dictionary member defaults false.
assertions.test: (async () => { const t = (await (await fetch('./momentum/')).text()).replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ').replace(/\s+/g,' '); if (!/simulate scroll inertia/i.test(t)) return false; if (!/un-initialized/i.test(t)) return false; if (!/momentum = false|defaults? to <code>false|defaults to false/i.test(t)) return false; return /physical/i.test(t); })()

assertions.describe: Executable doc-quality check: support rows cite BCD api/WheelEvent.json; vendor signals cite the ChromeStatus API record; the absent-WPT state is recorded honestly; no core_enums.py provenance.
assertions.test: (async () => { for (const p of ['', 'momentum/']) { const html = await (await fetch('./' + p)).text(); if (!html.includes('api/WheelEvent.json')) return false; if (!html.includes('chromestatus.com/api/v0/features/6631012282007552')) return false; if (html.includes('core_enums.py')) return false; } const t = (await (await fetch('./')).text()); return /no WPT coverage/i.test(t.replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ')); })()

assertions.describe: Executable doc-quality check: the overview records that the ChromeStatus and BCD spec anchors do not resolve and cites the resolvable #interface-wheelevent section.
Member page renders at 1280x800 with no document-level horizontal overflow and all nine dimension sections visible — chrome-devtools-mcp matrix evidence.
Member page renders at 390x844 with no document-level horizontal overflow and word-boundary wrapping — chrome-devtools-mcp matrix evidence.

Executable doc-quality check: the tree presents the embedded demo/constructor probes honestly — presence of the attribute, constructed-event echoes, and the CPS demo do not prove native momentum behavior.
assertions.test: (async () => { const m = (await (await fetch('./momentum/')).text()).replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ').replace(/\s+/g,' '); if (!/authored echo/i.test(m) && !/echo of the authored value/i.test(m)) return false; if (!/not evidence of platform input|prove nothing about platform|not runtime proof/i.test(m)) return false; return true; })()

assertions.describe: Executable doc-quality check: runtime claims are bounded by Chromium evidence — momentum_phase != kPhaseNone mapping, phase-injection unit test, and the CL's Linux manual-test caveat; no touchscreen generalization.
assertions.test: (async () => { const t = (await (await fetch('./')).text()).replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ').replace(/\s+/g,' '); if (!/kPhaseNone/.test(t)) return false; if (!/Linux/.test(t) || !/did not surface/i.test(t)) return false; if (/touchscreens/i.test(t)) return false; const m = (await (await fetch('./momentum/')).text()).replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ').replace(/\s+/g,' '); return /kPhaseBegan/.test(m); })()

assertions.describe: Executable doc-quality check: authored events can echo momentum=true and the authored-vs-native distinction is delegated to event.isTrusted (DOM Standard link present).
assertions.test: (async () => { const html = await (await fetch('./momentum/')).text(); if (!html.includes('dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-istrusted')) return false; const t = html.replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ').replace(/\s+/g,' '); return /isTrusted/.test(t) && /script-constructed events are untrusted|untrusted regardless/i.test(t); })()

assertions.describe: Executable doc-quality check: exact WebIDL dictionary-member semantics are documented — boolean default false, ToBoolean conversion (string 'false' is truthy), omitted defaults, unknown members ignored, none of it runtime proof.
assertions.test: (async () => { const html = await (await fetch('./momentum/')).text(); if (!html.includes('webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#es-boolean') || !html.includes('webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#es-dictionary')) return false; const t = html.replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ').replace(/\s+/g,' '); return /truthy/i.test(t) && /momentum = false/.test(t) && /ignored/i.test(t) && /runtime proof/i.test(t); })()

assertions.describe: Executable doc-quality check: both dead spec anchors (ChromeStatus #dom-wheelevent-momentum; BCD #dom-wheeleventinit-momentum) are documented as not resolving, with the resolvable section linked.
assertions.test: (async () => { const html = await (await fetch('./')).text(); if (!html.includes('dom-wheelevent-momentum') || !html.includes('dom-wheeleventinit-momentum')) return false; if (!/neither resolves/i.test(html.replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' '))) return false; return !!new DOMParser().parseFromString(html, 'text/html').querySelector('a[href="https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#interface-wheelevent"]'); })()
